translation.name: Pwapwior we e Santus
translation.englishName: Satawalese: Pwapwior we e Santus (New Testament)

content: Rhaepeto Kkewe Aaen Jesus Kristus
Ikkaan tettaenin rhaepeton Jesus Kristus, iiy erhaep saengi David, iwe nge David erhaep saengi Abraham.
Nge Abraham semaen Isaac, nge Isaac semaen Jacob, nge Jacob semaen Judah me mwaaen kkewe pwiin.
Nge Judah semaen Peres me Zerah (itaen ineer nge Tamar), iwe nge Peres semaen Hezron, nge Hezron semaen Ram.
Nge Ram semaen Amminadab, nge Amminadab semaen Nahshon, nge Nahshon semaen Salmon.
Nge Salmon semaen Boaz (itaen inan nge Rahab), nge Boaz semaen Obed (itaen inan nge Ruth), nge Obed semaen Jesse,
nge Jesse semaen king David. Nge David semaen Solomon, iwe e naini me wooan niewe pwiuniuwaen Uriah,
nge Solomon semaen Rehoboam, nge Rehoboam semaen Abijah, nge Abijah semaen Asa.
Nge Asa semaen Jehoshaphat, nge Jehoshaphat semaen Jehoram, nge Jehoram semaen Uzziah.
Nge Uzziah semaen Jotham, nge Jotham semaen Ahaz, nge Ahaz semaen Hezekiah.
Nge Hezekiah semaen Manasseh, nge Manasseh semaen Amon, nge Amon semaen Josiah.
Nge Josiah semaen Jehoiachin me mwaaen kkewe pwiin ikkiwe re asiiur nong noan Babylon.
Mwirin aar asiiur noa Babylon: Jehoiachin semaen Shealtiel, nge Shealtiel semaen Zerubbabel.
Zerubbabel semaen Abiud, Abiud semaen Eliakim, nge Eliakim semaen Azor.
Azor semaen Zadok, Zadok semaen Achim, nge Achim semaen Eliud.
Eliud semaen Eleazar, Eleazar semaen Matthan, nge Matthan semaen Jacob.
Jacob semaen Joseph iwe pwiuniuwaen Maria, niewe a nainitiw Jesus iwe re faingi pwe Kristus.

Seig me faawu saeren aeremas saengi Abraham ngaeni David, pwan seig me faawu saeren aeremas saengi David ngaeni oaton aar asiiur noa noan Babylon, pwan seig me faawu saeren aeremas saengi oaton we re asiiur noa Babylon ngaeni wupwutiwen Kristus.
Wupwutiwen Jesus Kristus
Ieen wunuunun aaen Jesus Kristus wupwutiw. Maria we inan a kkefoat ngaeni Joseph, nge igiwe resaaen pwiuppwiuniuw mwo nge a pwae pwe niewe a pwoopwo reen kkemenaen Espritu Santus.
Nge Joseph erhai mwaaen wenewen, ese mwerhaen aessaewa Maria me weni mmweer aeremas, iwe a niunniuwaennei epwene siusaengi, nge epwe feeori rhag noan mwoanomwoan.

Igiwe e rhiuwen niunniuwaennei wunuunun, erhai naiun Soamwoon angkenus a pwae ngaeni noan aan ttan nge a aengaeni pwe, “Joseph we tettaenin David, wosoapw mesag oamw wopwe pwiuniuwaeni Maria, pwe iiy a pwoopwo reen kkemenaen Espritu Santus.
Epwene naini erhai aetemwaaen, iwe wopwe aeita ngaeni Jesus,
pwe iga iiy epwe aemenewaar naiun aeremas saengi aar monofit.”
A wen oanongaen minikkeei pwe epwe pwaeritae meeta we profeta a aepesa pwe mwaeniaei Soamwoon:

content.text: “Erhai aeterhooapwut epwene pwoopwo nge a naini erhai aetemwaaen,
repwe aeitae ngaeni Immanuel”, (wewen nge “Deus eno reerh”).

content: Iwe oatowe Joseph a mmasetae, a feeori wunuunun miniwe angkenus we naiun Soamwoon e aepesa ngaeni. Iwe a pwiuniuwaeni Maria.
Nge Joseph ese maiur ngaeni Maria toori aan nainitiw aetewe naiun. Iwe, Joseph a aeita aetewe pwe Jesus.
